macro.headline: Global Geopolitical Jitters and Persistent Inflation Keep ASX on Edge, Favoring Commodities and Defensives
themes: Geopolitical Risk Premium: Escalating US-Iran tensions and ongoing conflicts maintain an elevated risk premium, particularly on oil and gold prices.
Higher for Longer Rates: The RBA and Fed remain steadfastly hawkish due to sticky inflation, pushing out rate cut expectations and creating headwinds for growth-sensitive sectors.
Persistent Inflationary Pressures: Elevated energy costs and service inflation continue to erode consumer purchasing power, impacting discretionary spending.
Fragile Consumer Confidence: The cost-of-living crisis, high interest rates, and economic uncertainty weigh heavily on consumer sentiment.
